purpose: Identify the actual prose-surface causes of target-reader AI smell using contrastive evidence, instead of continuing generic anti-AI heuristics or one-sentence deletion repairs.
required_evidence_planes: Human-positive bounded prose anchors, especially Phase363 and Phase369/370 directional improvements
Human-negative AI-heavy generated prose, especially Phase367 and Phase376 Attempt2
Phase373 control/candidate evidence showing natural baseline can beat explicit technique activation
Recoverable prose-surface evidence from the three real source novels without storing long copyrighted passages
required_method: Do not generate new fiction during the audit.
Separate story propulsion from prose-surface AI smell; no-skim is not evidence of natural prose.
Locate repeated surface signatures in AI-heavy generated prose and compare them against source prose and human-positive generated anchors.

Analyze sentence architecture, paragraph rhythm, inference/explanation habits, dialogue/action alternation, sensory staging, information packaging, lexical regularity, narrator certainty, causal neatness, and local unpredictability.
For every proposed AI-smell signature, require at least two located generated examples and at least one contrastive source/human-positive counterexample or mark it UNPROVEN.
Distinguish correlation from causal repair instructions.
Produce a ranked failure taxonomy with evidence strength and explicit non-rules.
Do not promote any anti-AI rule to generation use in this phase.
